verdict: A difficult week — spend spiked, leads dropped, and six milestones remain overdue.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your cost per lead climbed to $248.63, driven by a sharp rise in Google Ads spend that did not produce a matching increase in leads — the final three days of the period spent $220 and returned zero leads, which is confirmed waste being addressed now. Google spend is being pulled back and scrutinized daily until the conversion rate normalizes. Your Google Business Profile activity also dropped sharply in the same window, and two of your three profiles are converting impressions to calls at under 1%, so profile optimization is a parallel priority. Six agreed milestones — including intake owner confirmation, the booking bot, and the LSA heating toggle — remain overdue, and those are the direct gate to scaling budgets; movement on those items this week is the clearest thing that unlocks next-period growth.

highlights.phrase: cost per lead this period, up sharply from last week as spend outpaced results
jobs won in your CRM over the last 28 days, against 289 active contacts
overdue SOW milestones that are currently blocking the planned budget scale-up

watch_item.issue: Google Ads spend spiked 141% week-over-week while leads fell 50%, producing three consecutive zero-lead days at significant daily cost.
watch_item.fix: Daily spend is being monitored and throttled; the Local Services campaign that drove the erratic spike is under active review to prevent unplanned auto-spend days.
